'''Matcha Flavoured 0.3-alpha''' (published as "v0.3-alpha") is a release of [[Matcha Flavoured]], published on June 10, 2026, the day after [[Matcha Flavoured 0.2-alpha|0.2-alpha]]. It introduced [[Crystal Heart|crystal hearts]] and was the last version for ''Minecraft'' 26.1.2.<ref>{{Cite changelog|0.3-alpha}}</ref>

== Additions ==
* [[Crystal Heart|Crystal hearts]], which replace the earlier "heart containers".
** Crystal hearts can be crafted and are found in several chest [[Chest loot|loot tables]].

== Changes ==
* Refined the [[health]] system around crystal hearts.
* [[Zombie]]s no longer drop crystal hearts.
* The original vanilla recipes that the pack replaces are blocked again.

== Fixes ==
* [[Hell]] (the Nether) was completely dark because its ambient light was 0. It now has ambient light.
* Restored the "ping" sound of the [[Zephyr]] enchantment.
* [[Tools|Hoes]] can mine froglights (now [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]]) and wool.
